hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE 'api/src/tests/.*\.py$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER (CLAUDE.md Testing Workflow): this change touched a test file under api/src/tests/. Before considering this test-writing work done, spawn a subagent to audit the suite (KEEP/CUT/MERGE verdict per test), apply the agreed edits, and re-run the suite. Do this now if not already done for this batch of test changes."}}'; fi; }
